description: Compiles M0701A (main module, src/qrpglesrc/m0701s.rpgle) and M0701B 'JUCUTL' (nomain utility module, src/qrpglesrc/jucutl.rpgle, exports calcTaxTotal/sendMsg) separately via CRTRPGMOD, then binds them into one *PGM (F0701A) via CRTPGM MODULE(M0701A M0701B) ACTGRP(*NEW) - per work/design/part07-design-v1.md's 07-01 finding that ACTGRP/DFTACTGRP ctl-opt keywords inside a module's own source are only honored under a direct CRTBNDRPG compile (ilerpgref75.txt lines 24185/25080), so CRTPGM's own ACTGRP parameter must be explicit here. jucutlp.rpgleinc is /included by both source files (CPYFRMSTMF transfers it as a member, referenced via /copy at compile time - no separate compile step of its own). Calls F0701A once (M0701A's mainline calls into M0701B's exported procedures; both report via the QCMDEXC/SNDPGMMSG job-log technique already established in F0605A/F0606A, captured automatically by VFYLOG). Finally runs DSPPGM DETAIL(*MODULE) OUTPUT(*OUTFILE) to confirm two distinct *MODULE objects are bound into F0701A - the actual teaching point of this lesson.

steps.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = '&LIB' AND SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = 'VFYMOD' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
